seo.title: Jim's | Neighborhood Pub & Wood-Fired Pizza in Brooklyn
seo.description: Jim's is a neighborhood pub in Brooklyn, NY serving wood-fired pizza, cold beer, and good cocktails. Happy hour Mon–Fri 4–6pm.

about.heading: Pull up a stool. Stay a while.
paragraphs: Jim's is the kind of place where the bartender remembers your order and the regulars save you a seat. Worn wood, warm light, a good jukebox, and no pretense — just a neighborhood pub doing simple things well.

The heart of the room is our wood-fired oven. Every pie gets a blistered, chewy crust and a kiss of smoke in about ninety seconds flat. Pair it with a cold pint and you've got the best night of your week.

highlights.title: Local pours
highlights.text: Brooklyn beers on draft, rotating seasonals.

contact.heading: Right around the corner
contact.directions: Two blocks from the 7th Ave stop. Street parking is a Brooklyn adventure.
